answer: Work waits on the crystal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zenith of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the bridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
